shell_commands.command: cd /testbed && rg -n 'acl load|ACL LOAD|replicaof|start_server' tests/unit/acl* tests/unit/*repl* tests/integration/replication* | head -130; ls AGENTS.md src/AGENTS.md tests/AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null
cd /testbed && ls tests/unit/*acl* && grep -nEi 'acl load|replicaof|start_server' tests/unit/acl* tests/integration/replication*.tcl | head -130
cd /testbed && sed -n '430,525p' src/acl.c && sed -n '2200,2415p' src/acl.c && sed -n '2910,2945p' src/acl.c

cd /testbed && sed -n '940,1175p' tests/unit/acl.tcl && grep -nE 'user =|cached_master|createClient' src/replication.c | head -90 && grep -nE 'c->user|CLIENT_MASTER' src/networking.c | head -80 && sed -n '1,70p' tests/integration/replication.tcl

cd /testbed && cat tests/assets/user.acl && cat tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl && grep -nE 'proc (wait_for_sync|wait_for_ofs_sync|status)|wait_for_sync|wait_for_ofs_sync' tests/support/util.tcl tests/unit/*.tcl | head -65 && sed -n '1970,2015p' src/replication.c && grep -nE 'c->user == NULL|!c->user|c->user != NULL' src/acl.c && ls -l src/valkey-server && command -v apply_patch

cd /testbed && sed -n '1,115p' tests/unit/auth.tcl && sed -n '1,100p' tests/unit/acl.tcl && grep -nE -- '--only|--single' tests/test_helper.tcl | head -25 && grep -n 'wait_for_ofs_sync' tests/integration/replication.tcl | head -12 && ls -l src/valkey-cli && git --no-pager log -1 --oneline

cd /testbed && sed -n '78,145p' tests/support/util.tcl && grep -nE 'proc.*client|client list type (master|primary)|client list.*id=|regexp.*id=' tests/support/util.tcl tests/unit/*.tcl | head -65 && grep -nE 'clientType|primary"|master"' src/networking.c | tail -35 && command -v patch
cd /testbed && sed -n '1110,1165p' tests/unit/acl.tcl && sed -n '1,75p' tests/unit/bitfield.tcl && sed -n '220,260p' tests/unit/bitfield.tcl && grep -nE 'documentation|ACL' CONTRIBUTING.md | head

cd /testbed && git apply --recount <<'PATCH'
diff --git a/tests/unit/acl.tcl b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
--- a/tests/unit/acl.tcl
+++ b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
@@ -1116,6 +1116,47 @@
     } {*NOPERM*channel*}
 }
 
+set server_path [tmpdir "replica.acl"]
+exec cp -f tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl $server_path
+set aclfile [file normalize "$server_path/nodefaultuser.acl"]
+start_server [list overrides [list "aclfile" $aclfile] tags [list "acl" "repl" "external:skip"]] {
+    start_server [list overrides [list "aclfile" $aclfile]] {
+        test {ACL LOAD on a replica preserves the replication connection} {
+            set primary [srv -1 client]
+            set replica [srv 0 client]
+            $replica replicaof [srv -1 host] [srv -1 port]
+            wait_for_sync $replica
+
+            set alice [valkey [srv 0 host] [srv 0 port] 0 $::tls]
+            $alice AUTH alice ""
+            $replica ACL SETUSER alice -get
+            assert_error {*NOPERM*get*} {$alice GET acl-load-key}
+
+            regexp {id=([0-9]+)} [$replica CLIENT LIST TYPE primary] _ primary_client_id
+            assert_equal OK [$replica ACL LOAD]
+            assert_equal {alice bob default} [$replica ACL USERS]
+            assert_equal alice [$alice ACL WHOAMI]
+            assert_equal up [status $replica master_link_status]
+            assert_match "id=$primary_client_id *" [$replica CLIENT LIST TYPE primary]
+
+            $primary SET acl-load-key after-load
+            wait_for_ofs_sync $primary $replica
+            assert_equal after-load [$alice GET acl-load-key]
+            $alice close
+        }
+    }
+}
+
 set server_path [tmpdir "resetchannels.acl"]
 exec cp -f tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl $server_path
 exec cp -f tests/assets/default.conf $server_path
PATCH
./runtest --single unit/acl --only "ACL LOAD on a replica preserves the replication connection"
cd /testbed && ./runtest --single unit/acl --single unit/acl-v2 > /tmp/valkey-acl-load-tests.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -30 /tmp/valkey-acl-load-tests.log; exit "$result"
cd /testbed && git --no-pager diff --check && git --no-pager diff -- src/acl.c tests/unit/acl.tcl

cd /testbed && grep -nE 'proc (valkey_client|valkey_deferring_client)|proc.*client|select 9|SELECT 9' tests/support/server.tcl tests/support/cli.tcl tests/support/redis.tcl tests/test_helper.tcl 2>/dev/null | head -65 && grep -nE 'valkey_client' tests/unit/acl.tcl tests/unit/acl-v2.tcl | head -35 && grep -n 'proc valkey_deferring_client' tests/support/*.tcl
cd /testbed && grep -n -A8 -B4 'ACL LOAD on a replica' /tmp/valkey-acl-load-tests.log && grep -nE 'dbnum|select|select.*9' tests/support/server.tcl | tail -25

cd /testbed && sed -n '222,241p' tests/test_helper.tcl && git apply --recount <<'PATCH'
diff --git a/tests/unit/acl.tcl b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
--- a/tests/unit/acl.tcl
+++ b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
@@ -1127,7 +1127,7 @@
             $replica replicaof [srv -1 host] [srv -1 port]
             wait_for_sync $replica
 
-            set alice [valkey [srv 0 host] [srv 0 port] 0 $::tls]
+            set alice [valkey_client]
             $alice AUTH alice ""
             $replica ACL SETUSER alice -get
             assert_error {*NOPERM*get*} {$alice GET acl-load-key}
PATCH
./runtest --single unit/acl --single unit/acl-v2 > /tmp/valkey-acl-load-tests.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -19 /tmp/valkey-acl-load-tests.log; exit "$result"

cd /testbed && git --no-pager diff --check && git --no-pager status --short && grep -F '[ok]: ACL LOAD on a replica preserves the replication connection' /tmp/valkey-acl-load-tests.log && git --no-pager diff --stat && rm /tmp/valkey-acl-load-build.log /tmp/valkey-acl-load-tests.log
